title: Evidence-guided exact-budget design
english_caption: Evidence-guided exact-budget design. The frozen PLM supplies WT representations to the unchanged Policy and Scorer. Archived homolog alignments yield deletion seeds and retained anchors; Policy completes each legal proposal to the exact budget before candidate-pool deduplication, backfill and Scorer selection. Without a legal proposal, the original K8 pool is returned exactly. The actual 209-residue Sec6-domain example (2FJI, chain 1) retains a 12-residue seed and adds 30 deletions, producing the fixed 42-residue budget. Its realized mixed pool contains six original Policy and two homology-origin masks under the unchanged nominal 4+4 rule. The compact bars show actual Scorer scores shifted by their minimum for display; the star identifies the selected mask. No model is trained or updated in this workflow.

title: Evidence to structural outcomes
english_caption: Evolutionary evidence and structural consequences in the preselected positive C07 (2FJI, chain 1) and negative C04 (2XVO, chain B) examples. (A) Actual MMseqs alignment columns retain WT and homolog coordinates, deleted seeds and immediate anchors. Tracks show the frozen deletion plans in 1-based supplied-WT coordinates. (B) Enlarged native/DelePref/RAG overlays and paired local native-contact networks use the existing true C-alpha coordinates, identical case-specific cameras and edit-identity fits; native reference is grey, DelePref dark grey, RAG teal and homolog seed orange. ROIs are selected from the seed with most native external contacts and its native neighbors, without using variant quality. (C) Contact-fate stacks are the primary quantitative panel. Every full-WT native C-alpha contact (<8 angstroms, sequence separation >=3) contributes once to the fixed denominator: C07 N=536, C04 N=530. Counts classify deleted endpoints, retained-but-not-recovered pairs, recovered pairs, and unknowns (zero for both cases). Horizontal units are percent of that fixed denominator, not percent of retained pairs. Header differences use the distinct original common-structure correspondence and must not be read as the differences of these bars. C07 is a domain-to-full-length homolog comparison, not a full-protein natural deletion. Neither case measures experimental function.

title: Evidence and the 23 changed designs
english_caption: Evidence and decisions for all 100 frozen General WT. The header reports all-100 coverage; the 77 unchanged designs are summarized as 33 exact fallbacks (9 without reviewed homologs, 24 without a legal event) and 44 selections of the original Policy candidate despite legal proposals. The matrix expands every one of the 23 changed masks and sequences (21 completed, one refined, one direct), retaining both gains and degradations. Rows are ordered by route and WT sequence SHA, not by quality. Seed percentage is the adopted seed divided by its fixed deletion budget. Signed local-geometry and native-contact changes are the original unitless common-structure endpoints, RAG minus DelePref. The all-100 statistical population is not replaced by these 23 rows. The source-context strip uses all 476 relations in the 67 proposal-bearing WT, with mutually exclusive priority categories; context does not rate biological correctness. Figure S3 provides every WT row, including all 77 zero changes.

title: Matched-seed completion
english_caption: Same seed, different completion in the fixed E9 set. (A) An input-only rule chooses the largest seed fraction among cached sources without fragment/partial/truncated name flags, breaking ties by WT sequence SHA; the first admitted paired proposal is drawn. For 2oebA00, the 22-residue seed and eight-residue completion meet the same 30-residue budget. The displayed Policy proposal is its selected final winner, whereas the displayed Uniform proposal is not; no proposal was chosen using structural outcomes. (B) Seed and remaining-budget decomposition retains every one of the 20 WT in the predefined roster order. (C,D) All 20 final-winner paired differences, including ties and degradation, are shown with the archived component-bootstrap mean and joint 97.5% interval in a separate shaded row. Local geometry: +0.023416 [ +0.001105, +0.052612 ]; native-contact recovery: +0.033043 [ +0.001862, +0.096187 ]. Both are unitless common-structure endpoints, Policy minus Uniform, N=20 components, 10,000 bootstrap replicates with seed 20261016. Seeds, anchors, budgets, original candidates, candidate quota, attempt rules and frozen Scorer are shared; completion-only deletion shape is not matched in this experiment.
